podcasts.name: Armchair Expert with Dax Shepard
podcasts.script: Quick one before we keep going. If you're in Mexico City, or heading there, Tierra, a sustainable sneaker start-up, is opening its very first pop-up store in Roma Norte on Friday, December 4. It's built for people who love Patagonia, Outdoor Voices and Warby Parker: footwear made for exploring, with the planet in mind. Stop by, try a pair, walk the neighbourhood in them. Details at {link}. That's Tierra, Roma Norte, December 4.

podcasts.name: Absolutely Not
podcasts.script: Okay, real talk: your sneakers should not be wrecking the planet. Tierra is a sustainable sneaker start-up, and it's opening its first pop-up store in Roma Norte, Mexico City, on Friday, December 4. If you love Patagonia, Outdoor Voices or Warby Parker, this is your kind of thing. Go, try some on, explore the city in them. Everything you need is at {link}. Tierra, Roma Norte, Friday, December 4.

partners.subject: Tierra en Roma Norte: ¿base para nuestro equipo?
partners.body: Hola, equipo de El Martigon: somos Tierra, una start-up de tenis sustentables, y abrimos nuestra primera pop-up store en Roma Norte el viernes 4 de diciembre. Según datos de gustos, sus visitantes coinciden muy de cerca (afinidad 0.85) con quienes aman Patagonia, Outdoor Voices y Warby Parker. ¿Nos dejarían usar El Martigon como punto de encuentro para nuestro equipo de calle antes y durante el lanzamiento? A cambio podemos ofrecer [su oferta, p. ej. dos pares de tenis para su equipo]. Más info: {link}. ¡Gracias!

english.subject: Tierra in Roma Norte: a base for our team?
english.body: Hi El Martigon team: we're Tierra, a sustainable sneaker start-up, and we open our first pop-up store in Roma Norte on Friday, December 4. According to taste data, your visitors closely match (affinity 0.85) people who love Patagonia, Outdoor Voices and Warby Parker. Would you let us use El Martigon as a meeting point for our street team before and during the launch? In return we can offer [your offer, e.g. two pairs of sneakers for your team]. More info: {link}.
